summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB bundle unrelated to advertised Vue component
details: @onereach/si-switch@0.4.5 is advertised as a Vue switch component but its package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated bundle (shuffled string/number array plus a custom decoder function such as `WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9`) with no readable code. Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is declared in the package manifest's `files` list, neither is referenced by the library entry point, and the executed bundle's behavior cannot be statically inspected or reconciled with a Vue UI component. On `npm install`, this causes an alternate-runtime dropper to execute arbitrary opaque code on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
